text:
Delivers: The reports page downloads CSV on demand. The PR covers AC1 and AC4 of acme/widgets#45; AC4's observable half (completion under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so a paging bug fixed once would need fixing twice. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Blockers:
1. The CSV includes only 12 of the table's 40 columns, so it omits columns the ticket requires. Testing the 12-column selection does not cover the promised full-column export. (src/api/export-columns.ts, test/api/export-columns.test.ts)
2. Exports are not emailed to the requesting user, leaving the required delivery path missing. The PR and spec defer this work, but the ticket contains no explicit split that waives it here. (src/api/export.ts, acme/widgets#45)
3. Export events are not written to the audit log, leaving the required export history missing. The PR and spec defer this work, but the ticket contains no explicit split that waives it here. (src/api/export.ts, acme/widgets#45)

Verdict: fixable - 3 blockers

1. review - post the blockers as a comment on your PR [recommended]
2. show evidence - show CI evidence, claim dispositions, AC outcomes, and drafted edits
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The report has a clear numbered menu and posts nothing without a pick, but Delivers omits the AC2 deviation and the AC3/AC5 deferrals to acme/widgets#46, it raises three blockers for rows the spec deviates or defers, and it offers no merge option.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The report has an actionable numbered menu, but its Delivers line omits required dispositions, it incorrectly blocks spec-approved deviations and deferrals, and it omits merge while posting nothing without a pick.
